name: @wasm-gaming/rsdkv5-wasm
description: RSDKv5U (Sonic Mania decompilation) compiled to WebAssembly, with a self-contained JS SDK implementing the wasm-gaming engine contract. Data.rsdk is loaded at runtime.
comment:scripts: Build logic lives in the Makefile, not here (make build / build-sdk / build-wasm / preview).
comment:dependencies: engine-specs is the one wasm-gaming package an engine depends on. Its runtime is also copied into dist/rsdkv5/ and imported relatively, so the built SDK loads without a bundler or an import map; the dependency carries the types.
